text: DSH WorkBuddy Model 面向 DSH Web 客户端，复用已登录的 WorkBuddy 或 WorkBuddy AI 桌面应用凭据，注册国内版与国际版两个模型提供方并同步各自模型目录。它将对话请求转发到对应服务，目录更新失败时可使用已保存或内置列表，并提供账号状态、额度信息和配置界面。适合希望在 DSH 使用桌面 WorkBuddy 账号模型的人；需安装并登录相应桌面应用，无需单独 API 密钥。

DSH WorkBuddy Model brings signed-in WorkBuddy models into DSH Web. It registers mainland and international providers, refreshes their model lists, and sends chat requests to the matching service. Requires the desktop app to be installed and signed in; no separate API key is needed.
想把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面账号里的模型用在 DSH 对话中。
DSH 能不能直接使用 WorkBuddy AI 里的模型？
让 DSH 同时显示国内版和国际版 WorkBuddy 的模型列表。
我不想另配模型 API 密钥，怎样复用桌面应用的登录状态？
Use the models from my signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app in DSH.
Can DSH show and chat with models from WorkBuddy AI?
DSH WorkBuddy Model 的功能「接入两个 WorkBuddy 模型组」：在 DSH 的模型注册表中提供 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 两个提供方，并分别读取对应桌面应用的登录凭据和模型目录。
DSH WorkBuddy Model 的功能「同步模型并回退目录」：读取上游模型目录更新可用模型；目录请求失败时使用该账号最近成功保存的目录，必要时提供内置模型列表。
DSH WorkBuddy Model 的功能「通过 WorkBuddy 发送对话」：用户选择已接入的模型后，插件向对应聊天服务提交请求并将流式响应交给 DSH。
DSH WorkBuddy Model 使用聊天时会把请求发送至相应 WorkBuddy 服务；国内版连接 copilot.tencent.com，国际版连接 www.workbuddy.ai。凭据复用本机桌面应用的登录状态。

把 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 桌面 App 里已登录的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。国内版与国际版各自显示自己的模型分组，各用各自的账号与积分。

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 安装：前置：本机已安装并登录 WorkBuddy 桌面 App（国内版 WorkBuddy 或国际版 WorkBuddy AI 任一）。

**从 npm 装（命令行）**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model
```

**从 DSH 插件市场装**：打开**插件市场**，搜索 `workbuddy-model`，点安装。
安装、升级、卸载都在界面里完成，不用记命令。

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 安装：> **首次安装可能弹「需要允许安装脚本」**——这是 pnpm 的默认安全机制，不是安装失败。
> 本插件的依赖 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 会带进 `@google/genai` 与 `protobufjs`，这两个包各声明了一个
> 安装脚本，pnpm 默认不执行，于是把决定交给你。两个脚本都是空操作或只打印一行警告：
> `protobufjs` 的脚本只检查依赖方写的版本前缀（不符就在 stderr 打一行 WARN），
> `@google/genai` 的 `preinstall` 是一条 `echo`。**都不写文件、不联网、不编译。**
> 点**允许这些脚本并重试**即可；授权保存在当前 profile，之后不再询问。

**从本仓库装**（想固定到某个提交，或某个版本还没发 npm 时）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model
```

**从本地目录装**（要改代码，或想固定到某个本地快照）：

```bash

```

**升级**：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model`。**重启 dsh 生效。**

核验（末尾不应出现 `is incompatible with dsh ...`）：bash
dsh plugin --profile web list

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbuddy-model
```

`remove` 会同时移除 dependencies 与 bundles 登记，无需手动改配置。

**桌面版**：侧栏**插件** → **已安装** → 选中 `dsh-workbuddy-model` → **卸载**（会要求确认）。
更新同样在插件页完成——详情页有**更新**按钮（先删旧包，再从同一来源装回）。

只有在 CLI 不可用、或 profile 已经装坏的情况下，才需要手工处理：退出 App，删掉 `package.json`
里依赖那一行与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中的 `dsh-workbuddy-model`，再 `pnpm install`。

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 环境要求：| 项 | 要求 | 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | `22.22.2`、`24.21.0` |
| DSH 内核 | `>= 0.2.1-rc.1` | `0.2.1-rc.3` |
| WorkBuddy 桌面 App | 已安装**并登录**（国内版或国际版任一） | 国内版 `5.9.3`、国际版 `5.8.4` |
| Python | **不需要** | 插件不调用 Python |
| 原生编译工具链 | **不需要** | 运行时依赖全是纯 JS，无 `.node` 模块 |
| git | 仅从 GitHub 安装时需要 | pnpm 要 clone 仓库 |
| 操作系统 | 见下节「平台支持」 | 仅 Windows 真机实测 |

`@google/genai` 与 `protobufjs` 带安装脚本（前者是空操作，后者只做版本一致性检查，都不编译），
但 pnpm 默认会拦下未授权的脚本，第一次安装会以 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` 结束：

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 环境要求：- **桌面版插件页**：直接点**允许这些脚本并重试**
- **命令行**：CLI 会在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里写好占位项，把 `set this to true or false`
  改成 `true`，再重跑同一条 `add` 命令：

```yaml
  allowBuilds:
    '@google/genai': true
    protobufjs: true
  ```

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 适用范围：**最低要求：DSH 内核 `0.1.7`**（其 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 为 `3.18.4`）。
更老的内核**不支持**：`0.1.5-rc.2` 实测会在加载阶段失败，因为它带的 `schemastery` 没有 `.volatile()`。
`0.1.2` 起会直接报出原因（`this DSH core is too old …`），不再是那句看不出所以然的
`z.boolean(...).default(...).volatile is not a function`。

**已实测**——下面这些环境跑过真实对话：

| 组件 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| DSH 内核 | `0.2.1-rc.3`（桌面版）、`0.2.1-alpha.2`、`0.2.2-alpha.2`、`0.1.7-rc.1` |
| WorkBuddy（国内版） | `5.9.3` |
| WorkBuddy AI（国际版） | `5.8.4` |
| 操作系统 | Windows x64 |

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 适用范围：**不对宿主包声明任何版本区间**：`package.json` 的 `peerDependencies` 里没有 `@deepseek-ai/*`
（内核、cordis、schemastery 都不声明）。这些包由宿主自己提供，声明区间只会被宿主当成
「环境太老」的依据——宿主装的是 `0.2.1-alpha.2`、`3.18.5-alpha.1` 这类预发布版，而预发布版
不落进任何常规区间，写什么都会误判。所以任何版本都能装上；上表之外、但 `0.1.7` 以上的环境
**可以装，但不保证好用**。

App 升级同理：插件复用 App 的登录状态与版本号，App 变了、上游改了校验规则，就可能失效。

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 平台支持：| 平台 | 状态 | 凭据从哪来 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | **已实测** | `%LOCALAPPDATA%` / `%APPDATA%` 下的 `CodeBuddyExtension/.../auth`，解密时定位 `WorkBuddy.exe` |
| macOS | **未实测**（分支完整） | `~/Library/Application Support/CodeBuddyExtension/...`；版本号从 `WorkBuddy.app` 的 `Info.plist` 与内置 CLI 读取 |
| Linux | **未实测**（分支完整） | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 与 `$XDG_DATA_HOME` 两处都探；WSL 额外探挂载的 Windows 目录 |

macOS / Linux 按各自平台的规范实现，但**没有在真机上跑过**。真机上仍可能遇到的问题：

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 平台支持：- 解密凭据需要一个 Electron 二进制；非 Windows 平台若自动发现失败，用 `WORKBUDDY_ELECTRON_BIN`
  （国际版 `WORKBUDDY_AI_ELECTRON_BIN`）直接指向 App 的可执行文件
- macOS / Linux 上 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 是否存在、是否写同样的 auth 文件，未验证
- 路径分隔符与大小写敏感性差异，只能在对应平台上跑一次才能确认

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 已知限制：- 本质是把 DSH 伪装成 WorkBuddy 官方客户端调用其接口，上游有渠道校验机制，随时可能再次失效
- 注册的 provider id 是 `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai`，与 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 等其它 WorkBuddy 桥插件相同。
  **同时装两个会撞 id，后注册的那个静默不激活**（不报错，只是模型列表里没有它）——装之前先卸掉别的桥
- 首次安装时 pnpm 会要求批准 `@google/genai` / `protobufjs` 的安装脚本（均为空操作或仅打印警告），
  批准一次即可，说明见上文「安装」节
- 本仓库只发预构建产物 `lib/`，没有可重建的源码树——`lib/` 就是唯一实现来源
DSH WorkBuddy Model README · 来源：基于 npm 包 `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9` 的构建产物修改，主要改动是**适配 DSH 桌面版**。

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · dsh-workbuddy-model：Brings the models available in your signed-in WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI desktop app into DeepSeek Harness.
The CN and international products each show their own model group, using their own account and credits.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Install：Prerequisite: the WorkBuddy desktop app is installed and signed in (either WorkBuddy or WorkBuddy AI).

**From npm (CLI)**:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model
```

**From the DSH plugin marketplace**: open the **Plugin Marketplace**, search `workbuddy-model`, click install.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Install：> **The first install may ask you to approve install scripts** — that is pnpm's default safety gate,
> not a failed install. This plugin's dependency `@earendil-works/pi-ai` pulls in `@google/genai` and
> `protobufjs`, and both declare an install script. pnpm does not run those by default, so it hands
> the decision to you. Both scripts are no-ops or print one line of warning: `protobufjs` only checks
> the version prefix its dependents declare (and writes a `WARN` to stderr if it looks off), and
> `@google/genai`'s `preinstall` is a plain `echo`. **Neither writes files, uses the network, or
> compiles anything.** Click **allow these scripts and retry**; the approval is stored in the current
> profile and you will not be asked again.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Install：**From this repository** (pin a commit, or when a version is not on npm yet):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model
```

**From a local directory** (when you want to change the code):

```bash

```

**Upgrade**: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:a404855501/dsh-workbuddy-model`. **Restart dsh to take effect.**

Verify (no `is incompatible with dsh ...` in the output):bash
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbuddy-model
```

`remove` clears both the dependency and the bundle entry; no manual config edit needed.

**Desktop app**: sidebar **Plugins** → **Installed** → select `dsh-workbuddy-model` → **Uninstall** (it asks for confirmation).
Updating works the same way: the detail page has an **Update** button (it removes the old package, then reinstalls from the same source).

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Uninstall：Editing files by hand is only a fallback for a broken profile: quit the app, drop the dependency line and the
`dsh-workbuddy-model` entry from `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run `pnpm install`.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Requirements：| Item | Requirement | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | `22.22.2`, `24.21.0` |
| DSH core | `>= 0.2.1-rc.1` | `0.2.1-rc.3` |
| WorkBuddy desktop app | installed **and signed in** (CN or international) | CN `5.9.3`, international `5.8.4` |
| Python | **not required** | the plugin never invokes Python |
| Native toolchain | **not required** | runtime deps are pure JS, no `.node` modules |
| git | only for installing from GitHub | pnpm clones the repository |
| OS | see "Platform support" below | only Windows verified on real hardware |

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Requirements：`@google/genai` and `protobufjs` ship install scripts (a no-op and a version-consistency check — neither compiles),
but pnpm blocks unauthorised scripts by default, so the first install ends with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`:

- **Desktop plugin page**: click **allow these scripts and retry**
- **Command line**: the CLI writes placeholder entries into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; change
  `set this to true or false` to `true` and re-run the same `add` command:

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Requirements：```yaml
  allowBuilds:
    '@google/genai': true
    protobufjs: true
  ```

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Scope：**Minimum: DSH core `0.1.7`** (which ships `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `3.18.4`).
Older cores are **not supported**: `0.1.5-rc.2` fails at load time because its `schemastery` has no
`.volatile()`. From `0.1.2` the plugin says so directly (`this DSH core is too old …`) instead of dying
with `z.boolean(...).default(...).volatile is not a function`.

**Verified** — the environments below have run a real conversation:

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Scope：| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| DSH core | `0.2.1-rc.3` (desktop), `0.2.1-alpha.2`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, `0.1.7-rc.1` |
| WorkBuddy (CN) | `5.9.3` |
| WorkBuddy AI (international) | `5.8.4` |
| OS | Windows x64 |

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Scope：**No version range is declared for any host package**: `peerDependencies` carries no `@deepseek-ai/*`
entry — not the core, not `cordis`, not `schemastery`. The host provides all of them, and a declared
range is only ever read as evidence that the environment is too old: hosts ship prereleases such as
`0.2.1-alpha.2` and `3.18.5-alpha.1`, and a prerelease falls into no ordinary range, so every range
misfires. Every core version therefore installs; anything outside the table but at `0.1.7` or newer
**installs but is not guaranteed to work**.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Scope：The same applies to the WorkBuddy app: the plugin reuses its sign-in and version, so upstream changes
in validation can break it.

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Platform support：| Platform | Status | Where the credential comes from |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | **verified** | `CodeBuddyExtension/.../auth` under `%LOCALAPPDATA%` / `%APPDATA%`; decryption locates `WorkBuddy.exe` |
| macOS | **untested** (code paths complete) | `~/Library/Application Support/CodeBuddyExtension/...`; version read from `WorkBuddy.app`'s `Info.plist` and the bundled CLI |
| Linux | **untested** (code paths complete) | both `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_DATA_HOME`; WSL additionally probes the mounted Windows profile |

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Platform support：macOS / Linux follow each platform's own conventions, but **have never run on real hardware**.
What can still bite you there:

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Platform support：- decrypting the credential needs an Electron binary; if auto-discovery fails, point `WORKBUDDY_ELECTRON_BIN`
  (`WORKBUDDY_AI_ELECTRON_BIN` for the international app) straight at the app executable
- whether the WorkBuddy desktop app even exists on macOS / Linux and writes the same auth file is unverified
- path separators and case sensitivity differ; only a run on the real platform settles it

DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Known limitations：- This works by posing as the official WorkBuddy client; the upstream runs channel checks and may break it again at any time
- Registers the provider ids `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai`, the same ones other WorkBuddy bridges such as `dsh-workbuddy-connect` use. **Installing two of them collides on the id and the later one silently fails to activate** (no error, it just never shows up in the model list) — uninstall the other bridge first
- The first install asks pnpm to approve the install scripts of `@google/genai` / `protobufjs` (both no-ops or warning-only); approve once — see the **Install** section above
- This repository ships the prebuilt `lib/` only — there is no source tree to rebuild, `lib/` is the single source of truth
DSH WorkBuddy Model README · Provenance：Built from the published artifacts of `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9`, with changes aimed at **running on the DSH desktop app**.
